tools.name: prepare_sauna_quote_request
tools.description: Validate a draft sauna project request and identify missing details. This is read-only: it does not store data, send email, select a provider, or share contact details.

tools.name: submit_sauna_quote_request
tools.description: Store a complete sauna project request and send confirmation and internal notification emails. Call only after prepare_sauna_quote_request and after the user explicitly approves submission. This never subscribes the user to a newsletter and never shares contact details with providers.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_sauna_quote_request · Private data: prepare_sauna_quote_request, submit_sauna_quote_request · Public sink: prepare_sauna_quote_request, submit_sauna_quote_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_sauna_quote_request · Private data: prepare_sauna_quote_request, submit_sauna_quote_request · Public sink: prepare_sauna_quote_request, submit_sauna_quote_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
